description:
Count New Zealand working days between two dates, or add or subtract N working days.

    Use for: 'working days between two dates nz', '10 working days from today
    nz', 'business days calculator nz', 'how many working days until
    christmas', '20 working days notice', 'subtract working days from a date'.

    THE END DATE IS COUNTED, THE START DATE IS NOT, unless include_start is
    true. Monday to Friday of one week is 4 business days by default.

    ADD AND SUBTRACT start from the next (or previous) day, so one business day
    after a Friday is the Monday.

    HOLIDAYS COME OUT ON THEIR OBSERVED DATES. A Saturday Anzac Day removes the
    Monday after it; Christmas and Boxing Day on a weekend remove the Monday and
    Tuesday. Waitangi Day and Anzac Day were only Mondayised from 2014, and
    Matariki exists only from 2022. A holiday on the weekend itself counts as a
    weekend day.

    A REGIONAL ANNIVERSARY DAY is excluded only when region is given, on the
    day it is OBSERVED that year, by Employment New Zealand's rules: usually
    the Monday nearest the anniversary (Auckland 29 Jan observed Monday 26
    January 2026), with exceptions such as Southland on Easter Tuesday and
    Canterbury on Show Day Friday in November. Available from 2010.

    Statutes often define working days with their own extra exclusions, such
    as 25 December to 15 January. This does not apply those.

    Args:
        start_date: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD.
        end_date: ISO date, for mode between. Counted.
        mode: between, add or subtract.
        days: Business days to add or subtract, at least 1.
        include_start: Whether the start date itself counts. Default False.
        region: Optional anniversary region key, for example auckland,
            wellington, canterbury.

    Returns:
        Business, calendar, weekend and holiday counts, the holidays met, the
        target date for add or subtract, and weeks and days.
name: nz_business_days_calculator
